summary_en: 2,000,000 shares (8.06% of shares outstanding), ¥2.5B upper limit, execution window 1 Jul 2026–25 Jun 2027, ToSTNeT-3 open-market method. Rationale: achieve 50%+ total payout ratio under JAST mid-term plan (FY2026–2028); portion to be allocated to employee restricted stock plan and executive short/mid-term incentive compensation; remainder to be cancelled.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
Japan System Techniques announced a treasury share acquisition program authorized by board resolution on 26 June 2026. The company will acquire up to 2,000,000 ordinary shares (8.06% of shares outstanding ex-treasury, based on 24,826,501 shares outstanding as of 31 March 2026) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥2.5 billion over the period 1 July 2026 to 25 June 2027 via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement (ToSTNeT-3).

The buyback is part of the company's JAST mid-term management plan (FY2026–2028), which emphasizes balanced allocation to growth investment, financial soundness, and shareholder returns. The acquisition supports the target of 50% or higher total payout ratio. The company intends to allocate a portion of acquired shares to its employee restricted stock plan (RS) and executive short/mid-term incentive compensation to reinforce human capital investment and enhance enterprise value. All remaining shares are to be cancelled by board resolution under the Company Law.
